ruleset.name: Claude Code Java quality gates
ruleset.description: High-signal hygiene rules; enable build failure after the initial baseline is cleaned. String literal comparisons and nullable String receivers must use Apache Commons Lang Strings.CS/CI.equals, Strings.CS/CI.startsWith/endsWith, and Strings.CS/CI.contains so comparison direction, case sensitivity, and null handling stay explicit. CharSequence emptiness checks must use isEmpty() instead of comparing length() with zero. Locale-sensitive case conversion must name its locale, boolean values must use Boolean.toString() instead of string-valued true/false conditionals, and critical file-permission results must not be discarded.

rule.name: UnusedPrivateNestedType
rule.message: Private nested type is never referenced in this compilation unit

rule.name: LiteralStringEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.equals for case-sensitive or Strings.CI.equals for case-insensitive comparison

property.name: xpath

rule.name: ReverseStringEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.equals or Strings.CI.equals with the nullable receiver as the second argument

property.name: xpath

rule.name: StringPrefixSuffixEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS/CI.startsWith or Strings.CS/CI.endsWith for String prefix and suffix checks

property.name: xpath

rule.name: StringContainsEquality
rule.message: Use Strings.CS.contains or Strings.CI.contains for String substring checks

rule.name: UseStringUtilsIsBlank
rule.message: Use StringUtils.isBlank/isNotBlank instead of String#isBlank so null receivers are handled explicitly

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseStringUtilsIsEmpty
rule.message: Absorb the null check into StringUtils.isEmpty/isNotEmpty instead of combining a null comparison with String#isEmpty

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseListGetFirst
rule.message: Use List#getFirst() instead of get(0)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseListGetLast
rule.message: Use List#getLast() instead of get(list.size() - 1)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseJsonNodeIsEmpty
rule.message: Use JsonNode#isEmpty() (or its negation) instead of comparing JsonNode#size() with zero

property.name: xpath

rule.name: LocaleSensitiveCaseConversion
rule.message: Specify a locale for case conversion (normally Locale.ROOT for protocol, identifier, and lookup normalization)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseCharSequenceIsEmpty
rule.message: Use isEmpty() instead of comparing a CharSequence length with zero

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseBooleanToString
rule.message: Use Boolean.toString(boolean) instead of a conditional returning "true" or "false"

rule.name: IgnoredFilePermissionResult
rule.message: Do not ignore the result of a file-permission change; check it or document why failure is harmless

property.name: xpath

rule.name: NoPrintStackTrace
rule.message: Use the project logger instead of writing a stack trace to the process stderr

rule.name: NoDirectProcessStreamAccess
rule.message: Production code must not touch System.out/System.err directly: route through CliOutput, or the project logger for diagnostics

rule.name: ExplanationNeedsAReason
rule.message: @Explanation must name why this declaration differs from the original product

rule.name: LambdaToStaticMethodReference
rule.message: Replace lambda p -> Type.method(p) with a static method reference Type::method

rule.name: AvoidDeprecatedJsonNodeFields
rule.message: JsonNode.fields() is deprecated; use properties() instead

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UsePlatformConstants
rule.message: Use Platform.CURRENT / IS_DARWIN / IS_WINDOWS / IS_LINUX (or Platform.OS_NAME) instead of querying System.getProperty("os.name") inline

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseHashUtilsSha256
rule.message: Use HashUtils (hashContent / sha256Hex / sha256) instead of calling MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256") inline

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseProcessUtilsIsRunning
rule.message: Use ProcessUtils.isProcessRunning(pid) instead of inline ProcessHandle.of(pid).map(ProcessHandle::isAlive)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseFileUtilsAtomicReplace
rule.message: Use FileUtils.atomicReplace(target, writer) instead of hand-rolling temp-file + ATOMIC_MOVE replacement

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseStringUtilsCapitalize
rule.message: Use com.claudecode.core.text.StringUtils.capitalize(s) instead of inline Character.toUpperCase(s.charAt(0)) + s.substring(1)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseStringUtilsFirstLineOf
rule.message: Use com.claudecode.core.text.StringUtils.firstLineOf(s) instead of inline indexOf('\n') + substring(0, nl)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: UseErrorUtilsMessage
rule.message: Use ErrorUtils.message(throwable) instead of inline getMessage() != null ? getMessage() : toString()

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ConditionalExpression[ InfixExpression[ @Operator = '!=' and NullLiteral and MethodCall[@MethodName = 'getMessage' and ArgumentList[count(*) = 0]] ] and *[2][self::MethodCall and @MethodName = 'getMessage'] and *[3][ (self::MethodCall and @MethodName = 'toString' and ArgumentList[count(*) = 0]) or (self::MethodCall and @MethodName = 'valueOf' and pmd-java:matchesSig('java.lang.String#valueOf(java.lang.Object)')) ] and not(ancestor::*[(self::ClassDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration) and @SimpleName = 'ErrorUtils']) and not(ancestor::*[(self::ClassDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration) and (ends-with(@SimpleName, 'Test') or ends-with(@SimpleName, 'Tests') or ends-with(@SimpleName, 'Properties') or ends-with(@SimpleName, 'Smoke'))]) ]
